concept: Бумажный робот складывается из тетрадного листа и чинит сломанный карандаш
subject: a palm-sized origami robot folded from plain white paper, square head, two thin arms, soft warm glow along its folds
visual_style: photorealistic macro footage, warm morning window light, shallow depth of field, muted natural colours

scenes.generation_prompt: The robot unfolds itself out of a blank notebook page on a wooden desk, its paper limbs creasing open one by one, slow dolly-in from a low angle
The robot walks across the desk between pencils and stops beside a broken pencil, camera tracking at desk level
The robot presses the two halves of the pencil together and the crack closes, close-up, slow push-in

narration: Обычная тетрадь. Почти. Робот находит сломанный карандаш. И чинит его за секунду.
title: Бумажный робот чинит карандаш
